decisionsTitle: The backoffice's tab bars show arrows when their tabs do not fit
decisionsSection:
The owner, 2026-10-11, looking at the section bar on a laptop, eleven tabs with the twelfth cut off at the right edge: the bar needs arrows in case it does not fit all. `AdminTabs` scrolled but set `scrollButtons={false}`, so nothing said that sections hid past the edge.

**Decision. This amends §79**, which dropped MUI's scroll arrows because they re-lay the bar out after mount and the desk's e2e story lost a click to it three times. MUI 9.4 still draws them only after an IntersectionObserver has measured the overflow, so the objection stands where it was made: on a phone. `AdminTabs` therefore uses `scrollButtons="auto"` **without** `allowScrollButtonsMobile`: below the small breakpoint MUI draws no arrows and the 320 px desk is laid out exactly as §79 left it (a thumb scrolls the bar), while a laptop and a tablet get an arrow at each end only while the tabs overflow, and none when everything fits. Each arrow is 44 pixels wide and does not shrink (BR-REQ-041-01 criterion 6). Because the arrows arrive after hydration and narrow the scroller by 88 pixels, the centring of the selected tab that §79 added now runs again whenever the scroller's width changes (a `ResizeObserver`), still only when the tab is not wholly in view and still on the scroller's `scrollLeft`. `tests/e2e/config-panels.spec.ts` walks it: both arrows drawn at 1024 px with the end one enabled, none for the Contributor, whose two sections («Ziua cursei» and «Ghid») fit.

The arrows are pointer-only: MUI gives them no role and no tab stop, and a keyboard moves through the tablist with its arrow keys, which scroll the selected tab into view. A disabled arrow at an end is invisible, not grey, and still takes its 44 pixels.

The editors' two language tabs never overflow and are unchanged.

**Refused.** A wrapper component around `Tabs` (`AGENTS.md` §1.3) and arrows hand-drawn beside the bar: MUI already measures the overflow and disables an arrow at its end. A second row of tabs: a wrap breaks the underline. A «Mai multe» menu: it hides sections behind a click. Arrows on the phone as well: the re-layout §79 dropped them for.
changelogLine: - **Arrows on the backoffice's section bar when its tabs do not fit** — shown only while the tabs overflow, on a laptop or tablet (44 px); a phone scrolls the bar by thumb as before. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The backoffice section bar shows scroll arrows, each a 44-pixel target, while its tabs overflow on a screen wider than a phone, and none when the tabs fit or on a phone (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN, amending §79).
